Recount from the listing (loop at &927E-&92CE, all in page &92; after the change .classify &9284, loop end &92D0, still all in page &92, so no in-loop branch or the BNE classify back-branch crosses; LDA rec_xh+boff,X max &B5E1 and movers_x_high,X &1366+33 never cross). Per path, old -> new: shown 3 (STX moved, same); x_high negative BMI-taken 3 -> CMP#+BCS 5 (-2, 14.0/pass); right of screen 10 -> 5 + 3 STX (12.7/pass); equal 8 -> 4 + 3 (4.3/pass); below, not equal 9 -> 4 + 3 (0.5); near listed 10 -> 8 (4.75); setup LDA zp 3 + INC A 2 + STA abs 4 = 9 once. Total 94.3 - 28 + 63.5 + 17.2 + 2.5 + 9.5 - 9 = 150/pass over 34 executions = 4.4 each, as claimed. Bytes: old 30, new 32 (+2 bytes, the claim's -2 saved). The unsigned compare against right+1 matches the old BMI/CMP/BEQ/BCS for every view the game makes (right_high 0..&4F, or &FF with left &FF/&FE: wraps to CMP #0, all classified as before). Only observer mode scrolling over 256 columns left of the world's start (right_high &81..&FE) lets a negative x_high reach near_screen and be listed; mark_to_draw's own BMI next and close_over_overlaps (rec_xh &FF, need 0) then do nothing with it, so only cycles differ. Knock-on of the +2 bytes from &929A to bank 4's end (&B37D -> &B37F, under REN_BASE &B400; no ALIGN in the bank, no branch out of range): BEQ in_hazel (&9CFC) and BEQ gathered (&9EFD) stop crossing a page when taken (-1 each); LDY wa_rows_guess,X (&A0F5 -> &A0F7) now crosses for X = 9, 10 and LDA straight_sprite_hi,X (&A4E4 -> &A4E6) for X = &1A, &1B (+1 each); the straight sprites' data move by 2, so draw_column's (d_ptr),Y reads change which 8-byte cell spans straddle a page (data-dependent, a few cycles either way). The mask/pixel tables are at &0400 (not moved). These knock-ons are a handful of cycles a pass of mixed sign against 150; the gate's measurement decides the net.
